baseUrl: Use the deployment origin supplied by the human; never infer authorization from this document.

mcp.resultEncoding: JSON in text content blocks; check isError and protocol errors

commands.name: person.import
commands.summary: Import one reviewed profile and optional birthday atomically. Existing profile/birthday updates require reviewed versions. Empty imported fields never erase values; no automatic duplicate merge.
commands.versionTarget: person and optional birthday for updates; none for new records

commands.name: person.create
commands.summary: Create a contact and third-party identity atomically. Name and reason required; group defaults to Other. No account or message is created.

commands.name: person.update
commands.summary: Edit or archive a contact profile. Profile changes do not count as meaningful contact; unresolved commitments remain visible.

commands.name: relationship_group.create
commands.summary: Create a relationship group with cadence days or null for off.

commands.name: relationship_group.update
commands.summary: Change group name or cadence inherited by contacts.

commands.name: interaction.log
commands.summary: Record an observed interaction, channel, date, summary, and meaningful flag. Does not send a message. Only meaningful non-voided interactions reset cadence.

commands.name: interaction.correct
commands.summary: Correct or void an interaction while preserving audit history.

commands.name: important_date.create
commands.summary: Add birthday, anniversary, or named date. Annual dates may omit year; birthdays must be annual and one-time dates require year.

commands.name: important_date.update
commands.summary: Edit or disable an important date. Changes can invalidate occurrence reminders.

commands.name: commitment.create
commands.summary: Record waiting_on or i_owe work with a human/agent coordinator, initially requested. Task links are informational unless human-required; linking needs task access.

commands.name: commitment.update
commands.summary: Edit commitment details, dates, or links. Only the human can change required status or move required work to another task. Linking needs task access.

commands.name: commitment.transition
commands.summary: Record a commitment state with a note. Fulfillment requires committed/reported_done; terminal states reopen as requested/committed. Only the human may waive. Never auto-completes a task.

commands.name: people_reminder.respond
commands.summary: Snooze a current People reminder or acknowledge an occasion. Use the attention projection occurrenceKey and subject version. Contact/commitment acknowledgment is not allowed.

commands.name: workspace.timezone
commands.summary: Set the IANA workspace timezone. Human only.

commands.name: profile.update
commands.summary: Update your display name and optional role/title. Human owner only; empty role clears it.

commands.name: project.create
commands.summary: Create a project with optional description and target date. Does not grant task access.

commands.name: project.update
commands.summary: Edit, archive, or reactivate a project without completing its tasks.

commands.name: decision.respond
commands.summary: Decline a proposal or request changes with feedback. Human only; creates no authority. Proposal retries require a new revision; returning a completion review reopens active work.

commands.name: reminder.snooze
commands.summary: Postpone a task, action, or routine reminder for its current version. Human only; changes neither status nor authority.

commands.name: reminder.clear
commands.summary: Bring a snoozed task/action/routine reminder back. Human only.

commands.name: workstream.create
commands.summary: Create a task with optional links (id, title, HTTP/HTTPS url, optional note). Human or explicitly scoped workspace agent; defaults to verified completion. The UI explicitly selects simple completion.

commands.name: workstream.update
commands.summary: Update task planning, progress, next action, or links. Links replaces the full list: preserve existing entries when adding; omit to keep, [] to clear. Authorized agents can add, edit, and remove links. Workspace agents with workstream.manage may change owner, assignments, or project. Only the human can change outcome, mode, policy, criteria, or clear external conflicts. Preserve existing references.

commands.name: workstream.block
commands.summary: Record a blocker with cause, attempted resolution, unblock condition, and resolver.

commands.name: workstream.unblock
commands.summary: Resolve a blocker with an attributable reason after its condition is satisfied.

commands.name: workstream.review
commands.summary: Submit an unblocked task for completion review.

commands.name: workstream.close
commands.summary: Complete a task through its policy. Simple requires the human, assigned agent owner, or scoped workspace agent; verified requires trusted criterion evidence or explicit human confirmation. Unresolved blockers, executions, conflicts, and required commitments prevent closure.

commands.name: workstream.terminate
commands.summary: Cancel or dismiss a task with a reason. Human or scoped workspace agent; preserves the distinct disposition.

commands.name: workstream.reopen
commands.summary: Reopen a completed, cancelled, or dismissed task. Human or scoped workspace agent.

commands.name: action.propose
commands.summary: Create an immutable exact-content proposal for a task. Use supersedesId for a revision; previous approval does not transfer.

commands.name: action.request_approval
commands.summary: Request human approval of the current unexpired proposal revision.

commands.name: grant.approve
commands.summary: Approve one exact proposal revision for a grantee. Human only; does not execute it.

commands.name: grant.standing
commands.summary: Grant bounded recurring permission for exactly one task or routine, with operation, target, time, use, and declared-cost limits. Human only.

commands.name: grant.revoke
commands.summary: Revoke a grant. Human only; does not undo external effects.

commands.name: execution.start
commands.summary: Reserve applicable authority before external work. Choose exactly one action or routine. Requires the actor as grantee and no conflicting running/uncertain attempt. Does not run external tools.

commands.name: execution.report
commands.summary: Record succeeded, partial, failed, or uncertain observation for a running execution. Executor or human only; report is not independent verification.

commands.name: execution.reconcile
commands.summary: Resolve a running/uncertain execution with accepted evidence tied to that attempt. Do not repeat external work to resolve ambiguity.

commands.name: evidence.attach
commands.summary: Attach unverified evidence with provenance to exactly one task or routine. Use authenticated file upload for bytes, never raw storagePath claims.

commands.name: evidence.verify
commands.summary: Accept evidence as the human or independently verify as a scoped integration. Ordinary agents cannot verify; integrations cannot verify their own execution.

commands.name: evidence.invalidate
commands.summary: Invalidate previously trusted evidence with a reason. Human only.

commands.name: operation.create
commands.summary: Create a routine observed by Accord and scheduled externally. Human or scoped workspace agent.

commands.name: operation.update
commands.summary: Update routine purpose, cadence, expected time, or assignments. Human or scoped workspace agent; does not change an external scheduler.

commands.name: identity.create
commands.summary: Create an agent, integration, or third-party identity. Human only; does not launch a runtime or issue a token.
